name: Central Oregon Youth Conservation Corps (COYCC)
org: Heart of Oregon Corps, with the US Forest Service
city: Bend, Redmond, Prineville, Sisters, Madras, La Pine and Warm Springs, OR
what_you_do: Work in a crew on outdoor conservation projects on public lands with the US Forest Service. About 50 Central Oregon teens are hired each summer.
who_can_apply: Central Oregon youth ages 16 to 18. You need photo ID and papers that show you can legally work (for example a signed Social Security card or birth certificate) for I-9 checks. Staff can help if you are missing documents.
pay_detail: $16 per hour. You may also earn 0.5 to 1 high school credit depending on your school.
duration: 8 weeks, Monday to Thursday, 7am to 4:30pm (2027: June 21 to August 12)
deadline_text: Applications are open for the cohort starting June 21, 2027. The exact closing date was not readable on the page.
how_to_apply: Send in the online application. Go to a local info session in April or early May. If you are picked, you hear back by mid-May. Then you do a virtual orientation and fill out job papers, with direct deposit.
notes: Call 541-633-7834 with questions. The page lists the application deadline as June but the full date is not shown. Crews work at seven central Oregon locations.
